triage.notes: The feature was already present but had two bugs in the handler that caused it to fail silently in the specific cases cited. Both were fixed in April 2025.
triage.proposed_comment: This is implemented in `shared_web/flask_app.py` at the `internal_server_error` handler (line 92), which calls `repo.create_issue` on every 500 response. A pair of April 2025 fixes (commits 9aeaa3be and 81cd7a07) corrected the exception-wrapping and None-propagation bugs that would have silently prevented issue creation for the earlier 500s referenced here.

verify.final_comment: Implemented in `shared_web/flask_app.py` at `internal_server_error` (line 92), which calls `repo.create_issue` targeting `PennyDreadfulMTG/perf-reports` on every 500. Commit 9aeaa3be switched to using the unwrapped original exception for better stack traces; commit 81cd7a07 added a `is not None` guard that prevents a None from reaching `log_exception`/`format_exception` — without that guard, an AttributeError would propagate past the `create_issue` call and silently skip issue creation. The original examples (#12081, #12080) not generating reports was most likely due to unconfigured GitHub credentials (see #11200), a separate issue now closed.

own_evidence.detail: internal_server_error handler calls repo.create_issue targeting PennyDreadfulMTG/perf-reports on every 500; exception=exc is passed with the unwrapped original exception

log_exception calls repo.format_exception(e); if exc were None (pre-81cd7a07), traceback.format_exception would raise AttributeError, propagating past the create_issue try block and silently skipping issue creation
create_issue returns None early if create_github_issues config is false or credentials missing — confirms silent failure path exists for misconfigured installs, consistent with closed issue #11200

adds `and e.original_exception is not None` guard, verified this was the only change; without it, None propagated to log_exception -> format_exception -> AttributeError, bypassing the create_issue call
